name: OpenAB Broker
description: Open Agent Broker (openab) — Discord bot bridging to ACP-enabled coding agents. Builds openab from source; agent CLIs must be provided by other features.

version.description: openab version to build. Use a semver (e.g. '0.7.6' → tag v0.7.6), 'latest' to build from the main branch, or any git ref (branch/tag/SHA).

repoUrl.description: Git repository URL to clone openab from

defaultAgent.description: Which agent to wire into the generated config.toml [agent] section

configPath.description: Path where the generated config.toml is written

allowedChannels.description: Comma-separated Discord channel IDs allowed to talk to the broker (empty = placeholder)

autostart.description: Start openab automatically via supervisor. Requires DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN to be set in the container environment.
